gloss: in order to; so as to; with the aim of

definitions.gloss: in order to; so as to; with the aim of
definitions.explanation: Formal expression attached to the dictionary form of a verb to indicate purpose or intent. The conjunctive form of べし. Common in formal written Japanese including news, business, and formal speech.

examples.japanese: ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解決|かいけつ}→解決：00136_kaiketsu⟧すべく、⟦{専門家|せんもんか}→専門家：03088_senmonka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{招|まね}いた→招く：02425_maneku⟧。
examples.english: They invited an expert in order to resolve the problem.

examples.japanese: ⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{達成|たっせい}→達成：04816_tassei⟧すべく、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧た。
examples.english: He continued making efforts every day so as to achieve his goal.

examples.japanese: より⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提供|ていきょう}→提供：12909_teikyou⟧すべく、{全社|ぜんしゃ}⟦{一丸|いちがん}となって→一丸となって：21196_ichigantonatte⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}んでいます→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧。
examples.english: We are working as a whole company in order to provide better service.

notes:
Conjunctive form of べし. Attaches to the dictionary form of verbs.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- Verb (dict form) + べく: 行くべく、⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧べく
- ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ → すべく (contraction): ⟦{解決|かいけつ}→解決：00136_kaiketsu⟧すべく (= ⟦{解決|かいけつ}する→解決する：17191_kaiketsusuru⟧べく)

Register: formal/written only. Not used in casual conversation — use ⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ or よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ in everyday speech.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: in order to — the everyday alternative
- よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: so that; in order to — used with non-volitional verbs
- べき: should; ought to (attributive form of べし)
- べし: should; must (archaic/formal predicative form)
